messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — found a mismatch between REST and SDK defaults for `preserve_whitespace`. REST /generate defaults to `false`, but Python/TS SDKs default to `true`. This changes token counts and breaks some evals. Anyone seen this before?
maria: When did the SDKs set `true`?
cheng: That was the SDK PR merged last week (link in the PR thread). Intent there was to 'preserve caller text by default'. REST team intentionally kept `false` for legacy/space-trimming behavior.
alex: Impact summary: tokenization + unit tests differ; some nightly evals fail. Need a quick decision on compatibility.
maria: I ran a quick repro — curl (REST) vs python sdk: different token counts. Repro snippets below:
```bash
# REST (default false)
curl -s "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"Hello \n  world"}'
```
```python
# Python SDK (default true)
client.generate("Hello \n  world")
```
Result: REST trims leading spaces while SDK keeps them => tokenization diff.
dev-bot: CI: build/4567 shows 3 failing tests in model-quality, 1 failing in sdk-integration (tokens mismatch).
qa-bot: Regression alert: nightly eval BLEU dropped ~0.02 for 3 tracked customers when SDK default=true.
cheng: Proposal: flip Python/TS SDK defaults to `false` to match REST, add explicit migration note and an opt-in `preserve_whitespace=True`. Pros: aligns surface area, minimizes customer surprises. Cons: callers who preferred preserved whitespace must opt-in.
maria: +1 to aligning with REST. Also add migration snippet and a short note in release notes about token-count diffs.
alex: Action items: cheng -> open SDK PR to flip default + add tests + deprecation-friendly warning; maria -> update release notes & evals; i'll ping REST owners to confirm no intent to change REST default.
cheng: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/789 (WIP). Includes tests and a compatibility shim idea. Tagging @maria @alex for review.
maria: :thumbsup: include explicit examples for py/ts showing `preserve_whitespace=True` and mention token delta numbers for our canonical prompts.
cheng: Implementation note: using `None` sentinel to preserve explicit callers — if `preserve_whitespace is None: preserve_whitespace = False; warn_once()` so we emit a single process-level warning when callers didn't pass it. Will add unit test asserting the warning is emitted exactly once.
alex: Good. Timeline: PR by EOD tomorrow, release cut Friday. If anyone objects speak now.
maria: No objections. Also propose adding a Console feature flag so we can force `preserve_whitespace=true` per-customer if needed during rollouts.
qa-bot: I'll queue a re-run of nightly evals against the canary SDK build after PR merges.
dev-bot: Reminder: please add integration test asserting SDK tokenization matches REST for the canonical prompt set (tests/integration/token_consistency.py).
cheng: Will add that test and update the PR. Assigning reviewers now.
maria: thanks — merge when green.
alex: I'll follow up with a short note to infra and support so they're aware of the changes in token accounting and potential customer tickets.
